name: second-reader
description: Truth-grounded literary criticism — an MCP server plus a long-form essay workflow. The MCP provides lit_search_texts, lit_verify_citation, lit_lookup_claims, lit_procure_source, and lit_verify_output against a pgvector corpus. Five skills (setup-second-reader, start-essay, build-reading-list, procure-sources, verify-draft) drive a long-form critical essay end to end against the corpus.
